turns.text: Currently I am working as a customer service officer in a telecom company in Islamabad.
My main responsibility is to handle the complaints of customers, for example when their internet is slow or bill is wrong.
Sometimes it is quite stressful because customers are angry, but I try to stay calm and solve the problem step by step.
I have been doing this job for almost two years, and I learned a lot about communication and patience.
In the future I would like to move to a team leader position, because I enjoy helping my colleagues also.
